content: Sai Kumar emailed insurance agent Anjali Desai to confirm the active status of his life policy LP-001234 and inquired about next steps, premium payments, and required documentation. Anjali confirmed the policy is active, stated that the next premium is due on October 15th with a reminder to be sent prior, and attached a confirmation letter for his records.

action_items: Agent to send a payment reminder a week before October 15th
